resources.string: Are you sure that you want to delete (%1$s) field?

Enter A Question\nThe question here is: any text, which you want to be an indicator of the answer, which you will enter below. The usefulness of the question is: when the app shows you the question, you should enter the related answer, which you will enter below.
Enter An Answer\nThe answer here is: any text which you want to study.
There is no entries in this field!
Enter a number greater than 0 and less than or equals 100, for percentage.
Are you sure that you want to delete this entry?
Please enter at least one value for day or hour
There is no entries in this time range!
Do you want to continue the previous studying session?
Please firstly complete or cancel any (study during period or test) paused sessions which concerning with this field!
There is an entry that has the same question and the same answer, delete this entry if you want!
Do you want to continue the previous test session?
This feature is not active on notebook fields!
Click to specify the date and time.
Enter a name for the file that will be exported (lowercase):
Enter a name for the file that will be exported!
Make sure that your SD card is plugged!
Your device storage is not prepared for the export process!

You will find your exported file in your external storage (almost,the SD card), under \"StudyWithoutPen\" folder. You might copy or share the file using a file manager in your device or using a computer.
You will find your exported file in your device (internal) storage, under \"StudyWithoutPen\" folder. You might copy or share the file using a file manager in your device or using a computer.
You will be notified when the process complete.
You must not close the app until the process be completed successfully. You can press home button, but don\'t press back button.
You will find \"StudyWithoutPen\" folder in your external storage (almost,the SD card). Copy the file that you want to import in this folder.
You will find \"StudyWithoutPen\" folder in your device (internal) storage. Copy the file that you want to import in this folder
Enter a name for the file that will be imported
This file does not exist! make sure that you have copied the file in the displayed path and that the file name is correctly written.
The imported file is invalid file.
Enter another name for the file. Currently, the folder has a file with the same name!
Select all the fields that you want to export:
Wait until the current export/import/emulation process finishes!
The following fields cannot be imported because you have fields with the same name but with different field type : %1$s.
The number of tries must be greater than 0!
The two numbers must be greater than 0!
Enter a number of questions which is smaller than or equals %1$d and greater than 0.
Enter values for the question area and answer area!
This feature is not available for notebook fields

Enter a number of tries here. The app will let you keep tring to enter a correct answer of the current question until your number of tries reaches this number, then the app will include the current entry in the wrong answerd entries and will show you the next question. If you entered a correct answer before the number of your tries reaches this number, the app won\'t include this entry in the wrong answered entries.

Enter the number of past days from now. Let\'s assume that you want to study all the entries that you have entered in the last five days, so, enter 5 here. Note that you mightn\'t enter anything here. If you entered a number here and a number in the hours below, the app will add them to each other, and will bring the entries of the result period.

Enter the number of past hours from now. Let\'s assume that you want to study all the entries that you have entered in the last five hours, so, enter 5 here. Note that you mightn\'t enter anything here. If you entered a number here and a number in the days above, the app will add them to each other, and will bring the entries of the result period.

This number is the share of the area of question of the whole area. If you want the area of question to become bigger, increase this number, if you want the area of question to become smaller, decrease this number. Of course, as the area of question is getting bigger the area of answer is getting smaller.

This number is the share of the area of answer of the whole area. If you want the area of answer to become bigger, increase this number, if you want the area of answer to become smaller, decrease this number. Of course, as the area of answer is getting bigger the area of question is getting smaller.
Choose the size of the text of the question and answer. Note, this doesn\'t influence the size of text that you determine in the system settings.
Please, enter the text for search!

By Percentage:
Enter a number greater than zero and smaller than or equals 100. The app here lets you determine the number of questions that it will ask you by entering a percentage of the number of the entries in the current field. Assume that the current field has 100 entry, and you will enter 50 here. According to this the app will multiply 100 * 0.50, the result is 50, so the app will ask you 50 questions. Don't enter the % sign.
By Number:
Enter a number greater than zero and smaller than or equals the number of entries in the current field. The app here lets you determine the number of questions that it will ask you by entering a number. Assume that you will enter 50 here, so the app will ask you 50 questions. If the current field doesn't have 50 entries, the app will refuse this number.
You should enter something in both the question and the answer
Both the question and the answer should have something
This may take some time, so don\'t close the app untill it notifies you. You can press home button, but don\'t press back button.
Study Without Pen!: the pause operation completed, you can close the app now.
Please, wait until the current test session pause opertation of this field finishes.
Please, wait until the current study a period session pause opertation of this field finishes.
Please, wait until any pausing operations of this field finish
This entry is already in this field!
If you are the one who has created this file, click yes.\nIf this file was created by others then shared with you, click no.
Copy the file that you want to import in the following folder:
Ignore the case of the letters while checking.
Read the answer (if you have answered correctly!!)
Select how to read the answer:
Text to Speech engine isn\'t available, so the app disabled read the answer feature. please go to Google Play and install Text to Speech to enable this feature.
The read answer feature has been disabled because the language is not available.
Schedule quick tests in random times
Please, enter number of quick tests, number of tries and number of questions.
Zero isn\'t allowed and the number of tests must be lower than 95
Exclude times from random quick tests
Any change will take effect starting from the next midnight
The number of entries in this field is less than the number of questions.
Schedule Quick Tests At Random Times
Control the entries of the test
Do you want to import the fields from this file?
This app collects anonymous data about the usage of it.
There is a field with the same name!
Cannot import entries to notebook fields using text file method
At least, one entry has not imported

The file must be text file txt
You cannot import entries to notebook fields
Every line in the text file must be formated as: 
field name@@@question~~~answer
Or:
field name@@@question~~~answer%%%rank of entry 
Rank of entry is one digit: 
0	Low 
1	Moderate 
2	Important 
3	Vital
Or:
field name@@@question~~~answer###order of entry
Order of entry is a number which is larger than or equals zero and lower than billion
enter a text that is not contained of any other special text
Are you sure that you want to disable the emulation in this field?
Enter the number of everyday entries
Enabling emulation of the field has completed
Wait till the running enabling/disabling emulation process finishes
Due running emulation process, some scheduled session has been canceled
Disabling emulation of the field has completed
IF YOU WANT, select the first entry

Enter the number of entries that you want to study everyday. Everyday, the app will emulate that you have entered this number of entries at that day. If the field that you enable emulation on it has 1000 entries, and you have entered 5 here, this field will take 200 days to finish. If you will add any entries to that field, the app will emulate that you have entered these entries from day 201, and so on.\nThe emulation affect on test features and study a period feature. The list of entries of the field will not be affected.

If you want, you can select one entry to start enabling the emulation from it. That entry and the next entries will be emulated, the previous entries will not be emulated.\nOnly the emulated entries will appear when using study a period feature, every entry at its emulation date.
